prompts: Create ONE standalone NORMAL DOOR game PNG asset extracted and polished from the attached purple Neuronest building screenshot. The exact door at bottom center is design target. Door closed, exact front view. Genuine alpha transparent background, no white/black background and no checkerboard. Professional smooth clean alpha silhouette with no white fringe or edge speckles. Portrait PNG canvas, entire door centered, generous 15% transparent margin around silhouette for future glow. One door only.
